faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: The questions our customers ask most often when booking with CineNova.

booking.question: How do I book tickets on CineNova?
booking.answer: Pick the movie you want to watch, choose a branch and showtime, select your seats and complete the payment. Your e-ticket appears under My Bookings once the payment succeeds.

payment.question: Which payment methods does CineNova accept?
payment.answer: You can pay online through the supported payment gateways offered in the final step of the booking flow.

cancel.question: Can I change or cancel a booked ticket?
cancel.answer: Paid tickets cannot be cancelled from the website. If you need help, please call our hotline before the showtime and we will guide you.

checkTicket.question: Where can I check my booked tickets?
checkTicket.answer: Sign in and open My Bookings to review every ticket along with its showtime, auditorium and seat numbers.

voucher.question: How do I use a discount code?
voucher.answer: Enter the code at the payment step. Each code has its own conditions and expiry date, and it is applied automatically when your order qualifies.

combo.question: Can I add a popcorn and drink combo to my tickets?
combo.answer: Yes. During seat selection you can add a combo and pay for it together with your tickets.

account.question: Do I need an account to book tickets?
account.answer: You need to sign in to book, which lets us save your tickets so you can look them up at any time.

contact.question: Who do I contact for urgent help?
contact.answer: Please call our hotline or send us an email and our support team will get back to you as soon as possible.
